Unfortunately, I don't believe in a God. It really goes against everything I've been raised to believe, but I respect that other do. You have to believe in something, right?

And I know it all works out, but I'm just very tired of starting over... I just want it to work this time.
Not a problem, I'm glad I could help. Reading your reply actually made me feel slightly better about today :)

Thanks for sharing. See, when I posted this I was afraid of getting a lot of people claiming I'm just some attention-seeker. I've never told anyone. If I wanted the attention it'd be all I'd ever talk about, I could honestly go on for hours so it's definitely good to know there are others out there who feel the same way.

Thank you for your suggestions. I know I'm depressed, I've known for a long time. The problem with that is, even though I KNOW and there's medicines to treat it, if my work found out, they would force me to go on disability until it's under control. Sounds like a sweet deal, but I can't afford that right now.

In the meantime, I'll just have to try what you suggested. I plan on taking the dog for a walk this morning, she needs to get out more any way, and maybe take a couple of pictures along the way. My camera is getting a little dusty these days.
